HN thread https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46837016 ('Build reliably with Google GenAI tech') and https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46384144 ('Ac2 - Agentic CLI Toolkit for Claude Code and Gemini CLI') confirm Gemini CLI skills as a distinct discovery class the current query set likely undercounts.

'Agent harness' is an emerging tool-class vocabulary distinct from skills or plugins. This session found: code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent (59k stars), affaan-m/ECC (191k stars), ruvnet/ruflo (54k stars), HKUDS/OpenHarness (13k stars), Chachamaru127/claude-code-harness (1.5k stars), revfactory/harness (3.5k stars), mvschwarz/openrig (Show HN: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47772935). None of these surface on skill/plugin topic queries.

AGENTS.md is becoming the Codex-ecosystem equivalent of CLAUDE.md and SKILL.md. Found 406 repos with agents-md topic, including leonardsellem/codex-subagents-mcp (HN: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45076146), TateZhouSiu/agents-md-kit, marcusquinn/aidevops, and Edward4226/codex-maxxing. HN thread https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46398957 ('An AI collaboration playbook - AGENTS.md') was referenced by multiple users. This vocabulary is absent from current query set.

propose.justification: Sandboxed agent execution is a new safety-oriented tool class. Found disler/agent-sandbox-skill (E2B sandboxes for Gemini/Claude/Codex, 367 stars), rivet-dev/sandbox-agent (run agents in sandboxes over HTTP, 1.4k stars). HN thread https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44723762 ('Give Claude a GitHub Codespace to automate') shows strong interest. Distinct from skill/plugin: these are infrastructure wrappers, not content packs.

Cross-agent orchestrators are crystallizing as a distinct category. Found andyrewlee/awesome-agent-orchestrators (550 stars), bradAGI/awesome-cli-coding-agents (446 stars), iOfficeAI/AionUi (26k stars), forketyfork/architect (Show HN: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46703935), mvschwarz/openrig (Show HN: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47772935). These repos sit between 'skill' and 'plugin' and won't surface on claude-code-skills or cursor-rules topic queries.
